summary.text: Beth Camp represents Georgia House District 135, which includes all of Pike County and parts of Lamar and Spalding counties.

paragraphs.text: She served one term on the Pike County Board of Education before running for state office in 2020.
She began as a 911 dispatcher at 17 and became a licensed emergency medical technician, and she owns Camp & Associates, LLC, a real estate brokerage.
She earned degrees from Georgia Military College, Clayton State University and the University of Alabama, and lives in Concord.
